description: This file defines the class 'AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions', which provides configuration options for an Azure Blob Storage-based state machine storage provider within the Orleans framework. It includes properties and methods for setting up the BlobServiceClient, container name, blob naming strategy, and lifecycle stage, as well as various overloads for configuring the client with different authentication methods.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options class for Azure Append Blob state machine storage provider in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to configure the BlobServiceClient using connection string, URI, callback, or credentials.
